report_comment.text: TFG encodes TFG protein, a recurrent partner in oncogenic rearrangements. ALK encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase involved in neural development. TFG::ALK is a documented ALK fusion in inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor. The rearrangement joins an amino-terminal partner to the carboxy-terminal ALK kinase region. Crizotinib is US-approved for ALK-positive unresectable, recurrent or refractory inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor in patients aged at least 1 year.
